name: Minitiger Virtual Sync
description: Server-side companion for Minitiger Desktop. Provides Minitiger profile sync, virtual-library services, background helpers, image maintenance and local trailer support.
overview: Server-side companion plugin for Minitiger Desktop.

versions.changelog: Minitiger Desktop companion release built from Desktop-Web plugin source 1.6.7. Includes the current server-side Minitiger profile, virtual-library, background-service, image-maintenance and local-trailer features.
